tasks.title: Generate environment and realization wire contracts
tasks.goal: Bind exact lock, payload inventory and realized closure identities to the shared M-16 schema conventions.
steps: First create/update the governing permanent anchors in vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-063-environment-model.xml for this task's contract, with desired-versus-implemented status explicit. Only then add executable types or tests citing those anchors. Final promotion/retirement records evidence later; it is not permission to postpone the source contract.
Use the existing format registry/codegen conventions and M-16-B envelopes; inventory every request, result, durable receipt and hash carrier that needs the new fields.
Define dependency roles, native-backend closure, file/link/mode/principal inventory and domain-separated ordered hash frames; distinguish recipe-input and produced-output identities.
Generate owned wire types/corpora; add wrong-target, unsupported-metadata and reordered-input cases with explicit recipe/schema epochs.
positive_cases: Equivalent normalized definitions yield the same exact lock identity.
Changing target ABI or one payload byte changes the appropriate identity.
negative_cases: A package URL or mutable version string substitutes for captured identity.
Windows IDs are serialized as Linux payload UID/GID.
acceptance: Generated types and retained records use one schema source and explicit epochs.
Metadata capabilities are explicit; unsupported privileged nodes cannot be silently dropped.
tasks.safe_stop: Schemas and fixtures pass while unimplemented target execution remains explicitly unsupported.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(formats): add environment realization and payload contracts
notes: Planned permanent destination: vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-063-environment-model.xml; the permanent contract is established at the start of this task; later retirement proves preservation.
formats/ writes are limited to registered schemas/corpora/generated bindings for this atom; no unrelated epoch bump. Full root gate remains with the coordinator.

tasks.title: Migrate legacy identity and supply-path readers
tasks.goal: Preserve old record meanings while adding exact build inputs, prefix constraints and replaceable source/cache locators.
steps: Create representative old records from the characterized schema and state which fields cannot be inferred; mark them legacy rather than synthesizing target or hermetic proof.
Implement deterministic readers/migration through M-13 primitives, retaining input/output/prefix identities and exact source/mirror/substitution policy.
Require complete recursive source/build/runtime inputs for new realization claims and keep provider-native versions opaque to Vibe SemVer.
positive_cases: Known old records remain readable with their original weaker guarantees.
A same-content mirror can satisfy an exact captured source with retained provenance.
negative_cases: Legacy existence-only binary becomes verified merely through deserialization.
A changed prefix or untrusted cache producer is silently accepted.
checks: TO CREATE: old/new record, missing-input and substitute-prefix compatibility fixtures.
acceptance: Every migration has explicit unavailable/needs-input outcomes for absent proof.
No source/registry/cache transport requires GitHub by contract.
tasks.safe_stop: Legacy/new readers agree with fixtures; no real store or installed environment is migrated during tests.
